name: Bruno Collection Importer
description: Import a Bruno (usebruno.com) .bru request/environment file, or a whole OpenCollection YAML/JSON export, into Voiden — HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSocket requests, OAuth1/OAuth2 auth, and environment variables.
author: Voiden Team
readme: Import a Bruno .bru request/environment file, or a whole OpenCollection YAML/JSON export, into Voiden — HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSocket requests, OAuth1/OAuth2 auth, and environment variables.

buttons.description: Opens file picker to select and import a Bruno .bru request/environment file or an OpenCollection YAML/JSON export

ui.description: Adds import button to left sidebar for easy request import

fileSystem.description: Creates a .void file from a Bruno request

dependencies.reason: Uses voiden-rest-api helpers to generate compatible REST API blocks
Renders the gqlquery/gqlvariables blocks generated from a Bruno request's GraphQL body
Renders the assertions-table block generated from a Bruno request's assert{} block
Renders the socket-request/proto blocks generated from a Bruno gRPC or WebSocket request
Renders the auth block generated for OAuth1/OAuth2

integration.description: Depends on voiden-rest-api extension for REST block generation

features: Import a single Bruno (.bru) request file
Import a whole OpenCollection YAML/JSON export (Bruno 3.0+'s Export Collection output) — walks folders and requests, producing one .void file per request
Support for all HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, etc.)
Import headers and convert to headers-table blocks
Import query and path params (params:query / params:path) and convert to query-table / path-table blocks
Convert :param URL segments to Voiden's {param} placeholder style
Import JSON, XML, and plain-text bodies
Import form-urlencoded bodies as url-table blocks
Import multipart form bodies as multipart-table blocks, with file fields resolved as fileLink attachments when the file still exists at its original path
Import a raw file body as a restFile placeholder block
Convert a GraphQL body/request into gqlquery/gqlvariables blocks (both .bru's graphql-typed requests and OpenCollection's graphql item type)

Convert a gRPC request into a socket-request block wired to its .proto file, method, and streaming type (unary/client/server/bidirectional) — request metadata and message body have no Voiden target and are not carried over
Convert a WebSocket request into a socket-request block (url + protocol) — a pre-authored message to send has no Voiden target and is not carried over
Convert auth (basic/bearer/apikey/digest/awsv4/ntlm/oauth1/oauth2 — all 4 oauth2 grant types) into a native auth block

Import a Bruno environment file (environments/<name>.bru) into Voiden's env-public.yaml/env-private.yaml tree — secret vars go to the private file, merged with any existing environments rather than overwriting them
Convert a well-formed assert{} block into a live assertions-table block; entries using an unrecognized operator are imported disabled with the original expression preserved
Import pre-request/post-response scripts and vars as commented-out pre_script/post_script blocks for manual review
Sanitize file names for filesystem compatibility
Uses voiden-rest-api helpers for consistent block generation
Generates markdown with proper YAML frontmatter
